q.q: Why is RBAC alone not enough to keep a cluster healthy when many teams share it?
o: RBAC limits which kinds of resources users create, but not how much CPU, memory, and storage their workloads consume
RBAC applies only to cluster administrators
q.e: RBAC 可限制使用者能建立的資源種類，但 Cluster 的 CPU、記憶體與儲存空間有限，仍需用 Quota 限制用量。

q.q: What do resource requests represent for a workload?
o: The minimum resources that the workload declares it needs; Kubernetes does not deploy new workloads when resources are insufficient
The maximum resources the workload can ever use
q.e: Resource Requests 是 Workload 宣告的最低資源需求，Kubernetes 會追蹤，資源不足時不會部署新的 Workload。

q.q: To what does a ResourceQuota apply?
q.e: ResourceQuota 作用於 Namespace，而不是使用者或群組；超過 Quota 的 Workload 無法建立。

q.q: In a ResourceQuota, which field lists the hard upper limit for each resource?
q.e: hard 列出每個資源的硬性上限，例如 limits.memory: 4Gi、requests.memory: 2Gi。

q.q: What is the difference between a limit quota and a request quota?
o: A limit quota caps the resource limits of the namespace's workloads, and a request quota caps the total resources they can reserve
A request quota applies only to storage
A limit quota applies only to pods without requests
q.e: Limit Quota 控制 Namespace 可使用的資源上限 (對應 Resource Limits)；Request Quota 控制可保留的資源總量 (對應 Resource Requests)。

q.q: After you set a compute quota such as requests.cpu in a namespace, what must every workload do?
o: Declare the corresponding request or limit
q.e: 設定運算 Quota 後，所有 Workload 都必須宣告對應的 Request 或 Limit，否則無法計算耗用量而被拒絕。

q.q: Which of these is a compute quota resource name?
q.e: 運算 Quota 包含 limits.cpu、limits.memory、pods、requests.cpu、requests.memory；count/deployments.apps 屬物件數量 Quota。

q.q: Which syntax limits the number of Deployments in a namespace?
q.e: 其他 Group 的資源語法為 count/resource_type.group，所以是 count/deployments.apps；count/deployment 不會生效。

q.q: Which syntax is used for object count quotas on resources in the core group?
q.e: Core Group 的資源用 count/resource_type，例如 count/pods；可用 oc api-resources 搭配空的 api-group 列出 Core Group 資源。

q.q: Why are object count quotas useful?
o: They reduce damage from mistakes and maintain cluster performance; some resources such as persistent volumes also affect external storage
q.e: 物件數量 Quota 可降低意外造成的損害並維持 Cluster 效能；Persistent Volume 等資源還可能在外部儲存系統建立實體。

q.q: Which command creates a quota that allows at most one pod in the namespace?
q.e: oc create quota 可用簡短形式建立 Quota，quota 是 resourcequota 的簡稱。

q.q: You create a quota with 'count/deployment=1', and the command succeeds. What is the effect?
o: The quota has no effect, because the correct syntax is count/deployments.apps
Only one Deployment can be created
q.e: Quota 具有擴充性，Kubernetes 無法驗證是否正確；count/deployment=1 不會生效。

q.q: How can you tell from a quota's status that it is written incorrectly?
o: An incorrect quota shows 0 used, while a correct one shows the actual count
An incorrect quota shows an error in the status
An incorrect quota is deleted automatically
An incorrect quota shows negative values
q.e: 檢視 Quota 的狀態：錯誤的 Quota 會顯示 0 個，正確的會顯示實際數量。

q.q: A pod count quota is exceeded. A Deployment is created successfully but never becomes ready. Where should you look for the cause?
o: The namespace events, for example with oc get event --sort-by
q.e: 有些 Quota 影響是間接的，Deployment 看似建立成功卻永遠無法就緒，要用 oc get event 搭配 --sort-by 檢視 Namespace 的 Event。

q.q: Which resource lets a cluster administrator limit the combined usage of several namespaces?
q.e: ClusterResourceQuota 以 Selector 選取多個 Namespace，並把用量加總統一控制上限，適合同一團隊管理多個 Project。

q.q: In a ClusterResourceQuota, where is the 'hard' field placed?
q.e: ClusterResourceQuota 的 quota 鍵含 Quota 定義，hard 巢狀在 quota 之內，並以 selector 選取 Namespace。

q.q: Which option creates a ClusterResourceQuota that selects projects by label from the command line?
q.e: 可用 oc create clusterresourcequota NAME --project-label-selector=group=dev --hard=requests.cpu=10 建立。

q.q: How can a project administrator who cannot read ClusterResourceQuota objects view the cluster quota usage for their namespace?
o: Through the AppliedClusterResourceQuota resource in the affected namespace
Through the ResourceQuota in the openshift-config namespace
q.e: OpenShift 會在受影響的 Namespace 建立 AppliedClusterResourceQuota，讓 Project 管理員檢視用量。

q.q: Which limitation applies when listing AppliedClusterResourceQuota resources?
o: You must specify a namespace; --all-namespaces is not supported
It is available only in the web console
q.e: AppliedClusterResourceQuota 要指定 Namespace 才能列出，不支援 --all-namespaces。

q.q: In the guided exercise, a Deployment requesting one CPU per pod is scaled to eight replicas without a quota. What happens?
o: Only two pods run and the rest stay Pending with FailedScheduling: Insufficient cpu
The pods run with zero CPU
q.e: Node 的 Requests 已達約 87%，只有兩個 Pod 為 Running，其餘 Pending，Event 顯示 FailedScheduling：Insufficient cpu。

q.q: In the guided exercise, after creating the one-cpu quota (requests.cpu=1), a new Deployment test-2 that does not request CPU fails. Why?
o: The quota requires every workload to specify requests.cpu
The namespace has a deny-all NetworkPolicy
test-2 exceeds the pod count quota
q.e: 設定運算 Quota 後必須指定 requests.cpu，未宣告的 test-2 因此建立失敗。

q.q: What is a limit range?
o: A namespace-scoped object that defines limits for each workload in the namespace
A cluster-scoped object that limits the total CPU of the cluster
A role that limits user permissions
q.e: Limit Range 是 Namespace 範圍的物件，為每個 Workload 定義限制。

q.q: Which object types can a limit range apply to?
o: Containers, pods, images, image streams, and persistent volume claims
q.e: Limit Range 可套用到 Container、Pod、Image、Image Stream 與 Persistent Volume Claim。

q.q: In a LimitRange, which field sets the default limits for containers that do not define them?
q.e: default 為預設的 Limits；defaultRequest 為預設的 Requests；max 與 min 為上下限。

q.q: In a LimitRange, which field sets the default requests?
q.e: defaultRequest 是 Workload 的預設 Requests。

q.q: What does the maxLimitRequestRatio (limit-to-request ratio) type control?
o: The maximum ratio between a limit and a request, for example a ratio of 2 means the limit cannot exceed twice the request
The number of containers per pod
The ratio of pods to nodes
q.e: Limit-to-request Ratio 限制 Limit 與 Request 的最大比例；例如比例為二，Limit 不能超過 Request 的兩倍 (本課程不介紹細節)。

q.q: What is a risk of setting the maximum in a limit range too strictly?
o: It allows workloads to exhaust the quota
q.e: 最大值可避免耗盡 Quota，但設得太嚴格會擋下正常的 Workload，應保留足夠彈性。

q.q: Why are limit range defaults especially useful for workloads generated by CI tools?
o: Dynamically generated workloads may not define resources, and defaults ensure consistent allocation
CI tools cannot run without a limit range
Defaults speed up the build process
q.e: 預設值適合 CI 工具這類動態產生、可能沒有定義資源的 Workload，可確保一致的資源配置。

q.q: Which component applies limit range defaults and constraints?
o: The admission controller in the API server, when pods are created
q.e: Limit Range 由 API Server 的 Admission Controller 在建立 Pod 時套用。

q.q: After a limit range is applied, the Deployment's resources field is still empty but new pods have requests and limits. Why?
o: The limit range modifies the pod's containers, not the Deployment
The web console hides the values
q.e: Admission Controller 影響的是 Pod 的定義，不會修改 Deployment；練習也確認 Deployment 的 resources 仍是空的。

q.q: You create a limit range in a namespace that already has running pods. What happens to those pods?
o: They are not affected; new pods get the limits after the Deployment is recreated
They are restarted immediately with new limits
They are evicted if they exceed the maximum
q.e: Limit Range 不影響既有的 Pod；刪除並重新建立 Deployment 後，新 Pod 才會套用。

q.q: A pod requests more memory than the limit range maximum. What happens?
o: The pod is not created, and a warning event is recorded
The pod is created with the maximum value
The pod is created and throttled
q.e: 超出 min 與 max 的 Pod 不會建立，並記錄警告事件。

q.q: If a limit range specifies only min or max and no defaults, what does Kubernetes do?
o: Copies the min or max value into default and defaultRequest
q.e: 只指定 min 或 max 時，Kubernetes 會複製其值補上 default 與 defaultRequest；建議明確指定，讓行為更可預測。

q.q: Which relationship between limit range values is required?
q.e: 數值關係須符合：max 大於或等於 default；default 大於或等於 defaultRequest；defaultRequest 大於或等於 min。

q.q: During a rolling update of a Deployment in a namespace with a quota, why might the update fail to complete?
o: Pods from both the old and new ReplicaSets count against the quota, and the total can exceed it
Rolling updates are not supported with quotas
The old ReplicaSet is not deleted
The limit range blocks image changes
q.e: Rolling Update 時新舊 ReplicaSet 的 Pod 都計入 Quota，合計超過時更新無法完成。

q.q: In the limit range guided exercise, the pod metrics show about 50 MiB of memory used while the default request is 256 MiB. What lesson does this illustrate?
o: Defaults that are higher than actual needs can waste quota, so evaluate workload usage first
The limit range is not working
q.e: 實際用量約 50 MiB，遠低於 Request，表示預設值高於實際需求會浪費 Quota；應先評估 Workload 的用量。

q.q: Why does OpenShift introduce Project and ProjectRequest instead of letting users manage namespaces directly?
o: Namespace metadata has security implications, and RBAC cannot allow listing only some namespaces
q.e: Namespace 是 Cluster 範圍資源，修改其 Metadata 可能覆寫安全措施，RBAC 也無法只允許列出部分 Namespace；Project 與 ProjectRequest 讓使用者自助建立 Namespace 但不能修改其 Metadata。

q.q: When a user lists projects, what does the API server do?
o: Lists namespaces, filters the ones visible to the user, and returns them in project format
Returns all namespaces in the cluster
Returns only the projects created by the user
q.e: 列出 Project 時，API Server 列出 Namespace，過濾出使用者可見的部分，再以 Project 格式回傳。

q.q: Which namespaced resources does the course suggest adding to a project template?
o: Roles and role bindings, resource quotas and limit ranges, and network policies
q.e: 任何 Namespace 範圍的資源都可加入；常見的是 Role 與 RoleBinding、ResourceQuota 與 LimitRange，以及 NetworkPolicy。

q.q: Why does the course recommend adding a limit range whenever you add a quota to the project template?
o: With a quota, workloads must declare limits, and a limit range supplies defaults to reduce that burden
A quota does not work without a limit range
A limit range replaces the admin role binding
The template fails without a limit range
q.e: 加入 Quota 後，建立 Workload 需要宣告 Limits，建議一併加入 Limit Range 提供預設值。

q.q: Which command generates an initial project template?
q.e: oc adm create-bootstrap-project-template 產生初始 Project Template，行為等同預設的 Project 建立，含 Project 與 admin RoleBinding。

q.q: In which namespace must you create the project template resource?
q.e: Project Template 資源建立在 openshift-config Namespace，例如 oc create -f template.yaml -n openshift-config。

q.q: Which parameter in the project template is replaced with the new project's name?
q.e: 在 objects 清單中使用 ${PROJECT_NAME} 等變數；常見參數還有 PROJECT_DISPLAYNAME、PROJECT_DESCRIPTION、PROJECT_ADMIN_USER、PROJECT_REQUESTING_USER。

q.q: When extracting resource definitions from a test namespace for a project template, what should you remove?
o: Fields that do not apply to creating resources, such as creationTimestamp and status
q.e: 以 YAML 列出資源後，移除 creationTimestamp 與 status 等不適用欄位，並把 Namespace 名稱換成 ${PROJECT_NAME}。

q.q: Which resource do you edit so that the cluster uses a custom project template?
q.e: 修改 projects.config.openshift.io/cluster 的 spec.projectRequestTemplate.name，指定 Template 名稱 (預設為 project-request)。

q.q: After you update the cluster project configuration, when do new projects include the custom template resources?
o: After the apiserver Deployment in the openshift-apiserver namespace finishes rolling out
q.e: 更新成功後，openshift-apiserver 的 apiserver Deployment 會推出新版本，推出完成後新 Project 才含自訂 Project Template 的資源。

q.q: How do you revert the cluster to the original project template?
o: Set the spec of projects.config.openshift.io/cluster to an empty mapping {}
q.e: 把 spec 清為空的 Mapping {} 即可改回原始的 Project Template。

q.q: Why must you set the rbac.authorization.kubernetes.io/autoupdate annotation to false before changing the self-provisioners cluster role binding?
o: Otherwise the API server restores the binding when it starts
Otherwise the binding is deleted immediately
Otherwise the project template is ignored
q.e: autoupdate 為 true 時，API Server 啟動後會把這個 Bind 改回預設值；要永久變更須先設為 false。

q.q: Which command disables project self-provisioning after setting autoupdate to false?
o: oc adm policy remove-cluster-role-from-group self-provisioner system:authenticated:oauth
q.e: 把 subjects 清為 null 即可停用自助建立；簡報建議避免用 remove-cluster-role-from-group，因為移除最後一個主體時會刪除 Bind，且只在 API Server 重新啟動前有效。

q.q: Which property customizes the message that users see when they are not allowed to request a project?
q.e: 在 projects.config.openshift.io/cluster 的 spec 設定 projectRequestMessage，例如指引使用者聯絡管理員；預設訊息為 You may not request a new project via this API。
